english.title: Fish for / take freshwater fish from inland waters in the Tweed district except by rod and line
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) fished for or took freshwater fish in inland waters in the Tweed district, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) except by rod and line
english.legislation: Contrary to article 23(1) of the Scotland Act 1998 (River Tweed) Order 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
fished for / took freshwater fish

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
As per subsections, 23(3) and 23(4), this offence would not apply to the following circumstances:

(3) In any pond or loch where all the owners are agreed, a right of fishing may be exercised by net.
(4) In any inland waters an owner or occupier may fish or take freshwater fish, other than trout, by net or trap.
